extensionDescription.message: A human-first browser command palette. Search tabs and bookmarks with ease, and run commands naturally with keyboard or mouse.

newTabHint.message: Open a new tab in this window

restoreHint.message: Restore the most recently closed tab or window

closeHint.message: Current window only · Keep pinned tabs

moreResults.message: Showing the first 100 results. Keep typing to narrow your search.

shortcutNotice.message: No shortcut assigned. Set one at chrome://extensions/shortcuts

errorGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errorClosedTab.message: This tab has closed. Choose another result.

errorDisconnected.message: The extension disconnected. Please reopen the palette.

errorNoCurrent.message: No current tab found. Please reopen the palette.

errorRestore.message: No recently closed tabs to restore.

errorBookmarkUrl.message: This bookmark is not a supported page URL. Script bookmarks cannot be opened.

errorNoTab.message: No tab available for this action.

errorMovedTab.message: This tab moved to another window. Search again.

settingsHint.message: Language, appearance, tab management, and shortcuts

languageHint.message: Choose the language used in zing.

themeHint.message: Use your system appearance or choose your own.

hotkeyHint.message: Change the shortcut for zing in Chrome’s extension shortcuts.

savedLocally.message: Changes are saved automatically on this device.

errorSaveSettings.message: Could not save settings. Please try again.

noResultsHint.message: Try a page title, URL, bookmark, or command

searchRankingHint.message: Prioritizes your frequent commands and preferred search results based on use. Saved only on this device.

rankingReset.message: Learned ranking cleared. Default ordering restored.

navigationHelp.message: Use ↑/↓, Ctrl+P/N, or click to select.

errorStorageTarget.message: Unable to identify the source page. Reopen zing on that page.

errorStorageChanged.message: The page changed. Reopen zing to read its current data.

errorStorageUnsupported.message: Open zing on an HTTP or HTTPS page to view its storage.

errorStorageRead.message: Unable to read this page’s storage. Reopen zing using its hotkey or toolbar icon and retry.

errorStorageCopy.message: Copy failed. Select the value in Details and copy it manually.

errorStoragePermission.message: Allow access to this website to view its cookies.

cookieAccessHint.message: Chrome needs access to the listed website domains (HTTP and HTTPS) to read their cookies, including HttpOnly. You can revoke access in Chrome’s extension settings.

cookieAccessDenied.message: Access was not granted. You can retry or go back.

cookieAccessError.message: Unable to request access. Please reopen zing on the website.

recentSearchHelp.message: Click to search, or press Ctrl/Cmd+F. Then release the shortcut key and type.

recentNavigate.message: Use ↑/↓, Ctrl+N/P, or click to select · Esc to cancel

scriptLibraryHint.message: Save scripts locally. Search their names to run on the current page; use Actions to copy code, edit, or delete.

bindingHint.message: Copy a setup snippet to bind Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab.

bindingEffect.message: Uses Chrome’s internal settings API to bind Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab to zing’s recent tab switcher.

bindingStepCopy.message: Copy the snippet below (your extension ID is already included).

bindingStepOpen.message: Click below to open Chrome’s extension shortcuts page.

bindingStepConsole.message: On that page, press $1 to open Console, then paste the code and press Enter.

scriptCopied.message: Code copied. Paste it into the intended execution environment.

scriptCopyError.message: Could not copy code. Select the code and copy it manually.

scriptRequired.message: Enter a name and code before saving.

scriptRunningBack.message: You can go back anytime; the running script will continue in the background.

scriptResultsTemporary.message: Results stay in this panel only

scriptResultCopyFailed.message: The script finished. Copying failed; use Copy Result to retry.

noRunnableScripts.message: No saved scripts yet. Search “New Script” to create one.

scriptEnableHint.message: Turn on “Allow user scripts” for zing in Chrome, then return here and run again. On Chrome 135–137, enable Developer mode instead.

errorScriptDisabled.message: Enable user scripts in Chrome to run saved JavaScript.

errorScriptVersion.message: Running scripts requires Chrome 135 or later.

errorScriptTarget.message: This script cannot run on that target. Reopen zing on the intended page.

errorScriptChanged.message: The page changed or is no longer active. Reopen zing on the intended page.

errorScriptUnsupported.message: Scripts can run only on ordinary HTTP or HTTPS pages. Chrome internal pages are not supported.

errorScriptAccess.message: Chrome cannot access this page. Reopen zing with its shortcut or toolbar button on an ordinary webpage.

errorScriptInterrupted.message: Execution was interrupted or returned no usable result. Check the page before running again.

errorScriptMissing.message: The saved script is missing or empty.

errorScriptBusy.message: A script is already running in this tab. Wait for it to finish.

scriptExecutionHint.message: The last expression is the result, for example localStorage.getItem("token"). Promises are awaited. Runs in an isolated user-script world with access to this page’s DOM and storage; page JavaScript variables and GM_* APIs are not available.

autoTuckHint.message: Organizes tabs idle for 7 days into a collapsed Tucked Away group. Pages remain open and can be restored anytime.

autoTuckOffHint.message: Turning this off returns managed tabs to the tab strip. After restart, matching groups reconnect automatically; uncertain groups wait for your review.

tabTucked.message: Tab tucked away. Find it anytime in search.

tuckUndone.message: Tucked tabs brought back to the tab strip.

errorTuckTab.message: This tab cannot be tucked away. Keep at least one tab available; pinned tabs and existing tab groups stay in place.

errorUndoTuck.message: There are no tabs left to undo in the last tuck-away batch.

tuckRecoveryHint.message: zing could not uniquely identify a previous group. Check the pages below, then confirm the group to continue managing.

tuckRecoveryMissing.message: No matching group in this window yet. Open the original window and try again. Until this is resolved, zing will not create another tuck-away group.

tuckRecoveryResolved.message: This record has already been resolved. Return to search to see the current groups.

tuckRecoveryForgetHint.message: Actions → Stop Recovering This Record leaves every page and group in place.

errorTuckRecoveryChanged.message: This group has changed. Return to search and review it again.

errorTuckRecoveryPending.message: Review the previous tucked-away group first. Search for “recover tucked tabs”.

groupMissing.message: This tab group is no longer in this window.

errorGroup.message: The tab group changed or is no longer available.
